actual_Boolean_family: K_(a,b) minus k disjoint matching edges (i,a+i), 0<=i<k; sign output +1 iff a surviving edge has both bits1
parameter_domain: pilot (a,b)=(2,2),(2,3),(3,3), all k0..a; full every2<=a<=b<=5, all k0..a; scalar identities every2<=a<=b<=32, all k0..a
symmetry: Part exchange a<=b and a matching relabelled to its first k coordinates; no truth-table or output-set symmetry reduction. Every nonempty output set is checked.
arithmetic: Integer FWHT and physical flips, Fraction, original source-SCC/BFS queue witnesses, full present/absent root denominator, exact weighted Fourier moment formulas and rational logarithm enclosures. No floating sign.
reference: Same surviving positive edge primes, both endpoint orders, rarity1/4, one global lambda=1/b, D=(1+1/(4b))^(ab-k)-1
checkpoint: Save each completed actual Boolean case immediately; small a,b<=3 actual traces retained for separate replay.
inference_limits: Exact finite validation does not prove all sizes. All-size conclusions require the separate forest and signed-moment proofs. Selected-event lower masses supply cost upper bounds only; no variational lower bound transfers.
